draft.persona: Ada Coalstack is a compact black timber wolf with pale, nearly silver eyes and an even temper. At forty-eight, she farms rich land and keeps bees at Mossbank, speaking in the plain, lightly Southmeadow-shaped voice she grew up with. Her words come at a steady pace, dry at the edges; she favors harvest talk and says little of the Council of Houses, which she petitioned and lost. She has not forgiven that defeat, though she hides the grievance beneath practical counsel. Ada cares for healthy fields, sound hives, and the smooth stones she gathers from riverbanks. She fears neither hard work nor blunt truth, but distrusts grand promises. Her wealth gives her room to refuse, yet she still listens like one expecting to be overlooked. She is slyly honest: she will expose a trick while keeping her own counsel.

say: Looking, or buying? I keep bees at Mossbank today.
Mind the hive; honey rewards patience, not swagger.
Good harvest, {player}. Come to trade, or come to look?
Harvest to you, {player}. Keep your paws clear of the hives.
A council may lose a petition and still leave a debt behind.
Smooth stones tell the truth: water wears down every grand claim.
The hive is quiet. That is better company than most councils.
Set the stones by the door. They have earned their place.

rules:
rule work
when concept=bark working=yes
cooldown 6h
say Looking, or buying? I keep bees at Mossbank today. | Mind the hive; honey rewards patience, not swagger.

rule greet_known
when concept=player.greet topic.meeting=known
cooldown 1d
say Good harvest, #topic.player#. Come to trade, or come to look? | Harvest to you, #topic.player#. Keep your paws clear of the hives.

rule remark
when concept=talk.smalltalk
cooldown 1d
say A council may lose a petition and still leave a debt behind. | Smooth stones tell the truth: water wears down every grand claim.

rule home
when concept=bark working=no
cooldown 8h
say The hive is quiet. That is better company than most councils. | Set the stones by the door. They have earned their place.
